sources.title: OAD Guides — Atelier Moessmer
sources.claim: Atelier Moessmer Norbert Niederkofler's exact address is Via Walther von der Vogelweide 17, 39031 Brunico BZ.

sources.title: Bruneck.com — Atelier Moessmer
sources.claim: The restaurant occupies a 19th-century villa in a historic park near the centre of Brunico, formerly part of the Moessmer textile factory.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Atelier Moessmer
sources.claim: Atelier Moessmer holds 3 Michelin stars and a Green Michelin Star.

sources.title: Atelier Moessmer — Partner Hotels
sources.claim: Partner-hotel list includes Niedermairhof and Hotel Langgenhof; Castel Maurn offers a complimentary transfer.

sources.title: Hotel Post Bruneck
sources.claim: Hotel Post Bruneck is a 4-star hotel at Via Bastioni 9 in the old town, with wellness and the COSMO restaurant; packages from €288 pp.

sources.title: Hotel Corso am Graben — Location
sources.claim: Hotel Corso am Graben sits at Via Bastioni 16 in the medieval town centre.

sources.title: Bruneck.com — Hotel Krone
sources.claim: Hotel Krone is a 3-star, 33-room hotel at Via Ragen di Sopra 8 in Brunico's historical centre, at the foot of Schlossberg.

sources.title: Hotel Bruneck City.Design.Apartments.
sources.claim: Hotel Bruneck City.Design.Apartments. is at Michael Pacher Str. 6 in the historic centre.

sources.title: Hotel Blitzburg
sources.claim: Hotel Blitzburg is a family-run hotel at Via Europa 10, near the historic centre and the train/bus station.

sources.title: Booking.com — Hotel Blitzburg
sources.claim: Hotel Blitzburg holds a 9.2/10 Booking.com guest rating across 575+ reviews and is ~100 m from Brunico train station.

sources.title: Booking.com — Hotel ANDER
sources.claim: Hotel ANDER (formerly Andreas Hofer) is at Via Campo Tures 1, 5 min walk from Brunico centre, with garden, pool, spa.

sources.title: Hotel Langgenhof
sources.claim: Hotel Langgenhof is a 4-star at San Nicolò 11 in Stegen, a short panoramic riverside walk to the centre.

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Niedermairhof B&B
sources.claim: Niedermairhof B&B rated 5.0/5 on Tripadvisor (#3 of 9 Brunico B&Bs); ~25-min walk to Atelier Moessmer.

sources.title: Niedermairhof B&B
sources.claim: Niedermairhof is a boutique 8-room B&B in a restored historic manor in Teodone/Dietenheim.

sources.title: The World's 50 Best — Atelier Moessmer
sources.claim: Atelier Moessmer ranked No. 20 on The World's 50 Best Restaurants 2025.
